name: Karnu
passives: Ma’at Source Law: Karnu gains Solar Charge when its artillery choices express Solar Dominion of Khepra source-culture law through Aten-lit judgment ground; Earth myth is only the later echo.
lore: Karnu is the long sight of the solar barque: he reads enemies where sky, river, and desert meet. Human obelisks and horizon sanctuaries are static imitations of his living range geometry.
personality: Ancient, immense, purposeful, and bound to the survival philosophy of its Realm.
visualDescription: Artillery deity with sweeping solar-barge shoulder arcs, desert-glass lens organs, falcon-eye targeting visor, bronze horizon vanes, lapis braces, and mirage-light cannon geometry grown from the body. Avoid sci-fi sniper/mech; every range element should feel like sacred astronomy made alive.
developmentStatus: Combat kit, source-culture weapons, gear, abilities, leveling hooks, and balance pass complete; artwork pending.

abilityDetails.name: Karnu — Ma’at-Weighted Strike Longshot
abilityDetails.effect: Deal Aten Ra source-culture damage at range 5; generate Momentum and a small Solar Charge gain when used from Aten-lit judgment ground or against the marked target. The hit reads visually as Aten hand-rays, Ma’at scale seams, electrum collars, faience/lapis inlay, scarab cores, pylon shields, Nile-black and desert-red balance.
abilityDetails.scaling: 100% attack; +15% when the target is vulnerable or standing in faction-favored terrain
abilityDetails.counterplay: Break line of sight, deny favored terrain, bait the mark, or force the Deity into low-value targets.

abilityDetails.name: Pylon Edict Technique — Horizon Lock
abilityDetails.effect: Spend Momentum to marks distant lanes, punishes exposed routes, and demands line-of-sight counterplay. Builds Solar Charge only when the Avatar uses Aten-lit judgment ground intelligently; never a generic buff button.
abilityDetails.scaling: 70% attack plus role utility scaling from energy and mastery tier
abilityDetails.counterplay: Interrupt before resolution, spread enemy ranks, deny the setup terrain, or bait the cooldown.

abilityDetails.name: Karnu: Sun-Scale Decree Cataclysm Line
abilityDetails.effect: Spend stored Solar Charge to impose a two-round rule from Solar Dominion of Khepra: marks distant lanes, punishes exposed routes, and demands line-of-sight counterplay. Enemies receive a readable counter-window before the strongest effect lands.
abilityDetails.scaling: 140% attack where damage applies; utility duration +1 at mastery tier 4
abilityDetails.counterplay: Move out of the rule zone, drain Momentum/Divinity, stagger the Deity, or exploit the exposed recovery turn.

abilityDetails.name: Divine Ascension — Aten-Ra Source Radiance
abilityDetails.effect: Enter Ascendant stance for 2 rounds: amplify Solar Charge, transform nearby terrain into Aten-lit judgment ground, empower one Signature, and reveal the Realm as the original source behind human myth. Ends with a one-round recovery risk.
abilityDetails.scaling: Does not stack with external ultimate buffs
abilityDetails.counterplay: Survive the window, disengage from transformed terrain, deny objectives during recovery, or force defensive reaction spending.

equipmentDetails.name: Karnu Far-Sight Ma’at Was-Sceptre Blade
equipmentDetails.effect: +3 attack. Basic attacks gain +4 Momentum once per round when they express source-culture canon through Aten-lit judgment ground. Visual: Aten hand-rays, Ma’at scale seams, electrum collars, faience/lapis inlay, scarab cores, pylon shields, Nile-black and desert-red balance.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: No extra action loops; empowered basics are once per round.

equipmentDetails.name: Karnu Electrum Wesekh Source-Plate
equipmentDetails.effect: Improves survivability and makes the Deity read as Solar Dominion of Khepra source-culture gear, not costume armor. Reduces first terrain/hazard punishment each encounter if the Avatar followed the faction mechanic.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: Mitigation cannot stack past role caps; does not erase telegraphed boss danger.

equipmentDetails.name: Karnu Khepri Solar Scarab Core
equipmentDetails.effect: Stores Solar Charge and unlocks a mastery branch for Aten Hand-Ray Gate Step, Uraeus Counter-Edict, and Weigh the Name. Rewards correct terrain and reaction play rather than passive stat gain.
equipmentDetails.balanceGuardrail: Resource refund has a per-round cap and cannot chain Ascension windows.

leveling.powerFormula: hp + attack*6 + range*5 + energy*7 + speed*6 + armor*2 + resistance*2 + critChance

balanceNotes.intendedDifficulty: Tuned for harder solo encounters: every deity can win alone, but mistakes against counters starve Momentum/Divinity.
balanceNotes.primaryRole: project damage into crowds and objective zones

mythicSource: Solar barque horizon + desert glass + long-range Ra sight
armorCanon: barque-arc shoulder rig, desert-glass lens array, falcon-eye sight lines, polished bronze range vanes, lapis shadow braces
